texts.text_1: Whenever gauges are not placed on a packager...
texts.text_2: They will instead monitor stock levels of all linked inventories
texts.text_3: Right-click it with the item that should be monitored
texts.text_4: It will now display the total amount present on the network
texts.text_5: The gauge can replenish stock levels by sending other items to be processed
texts.text_6: First, add the required ingredients as new factory gauges
texts.text_7: From the target's UI, new connections can be made
texts.text_8: For aesthetics, input panels can be wrenched to change the pathing
texts.text_9: In the UI, review the inputs and specify how much of the output gets made per batch
texts.text_10: Specify the address that ingredients should be sent to
texts.text_11: The target amount to maintain can now be set by holding Right-click on the gauge
texts.text_12: Whenever the network has fewer items than the amount...
texts.text_13: ...it will send new ingredients to the specified address
texts.text_14: The outputs then need to return to any of the linked inventories
texts.text_15: Green connections indicate that the target amount has been reached
texts.text_16: The board of gauges can expand to include more recipe steps
texts.text_17: Each gauge maintains the stock level of its item independently
